verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets a free QuickBooks migration that claims no data loss. It also documents bulk CSV import of manual journal entries and the chart of accounts, which offers a path for books from other systems. The evidence is marketing taglines only: there is no help article on how migration works or which transaction-level fields carry over. Missing for 10: documented migration mechanics showing preserved transaction detail (memos, vendors, attachments, classes), migration sources beyond QuickBooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a lossless migration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail

citations.quote: Migrate from QuickBooks without lifting a finger or losing your client's data
you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template
If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
